steps.title: Prepare pipette and deck layout
steps.instruction: Use a P1000 single‑channel pipette. Arrange up to forty‑eight 3 mL clinical sample tubes in deck slot 8 or 9 (position A1 for the first sample). Place four empty aliquot tubes for each sample in deck slot 10 at positions A1, B1, C1 and D1. The aliquot volumes will be 1 mL, 0.5 mL, 0.5 mL and 1 mL respectively.

steps.title: Aliquot first clinical sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the specified volumes from the first clinical sample tube (A1) to the four aliquot tubes in slot 10.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 1 mL from the sample tube A1 and dispense into aliquot tube A1 (slot 10).
Aspirate 0.5 mL from the same sample tube and dispense into aliquot tube B1 (slot 10).
Aspirate 0.5 mL from the same sample tube and dispense into aliquot tube C1 (slot 10).
Aspirate 1 mL from the same sample tube and dispense into aliquot tube D1 (slot 10).

steps.title: Repeat for remaining samples
steps.instruction: Perform the same four aspirate‑and‑dispense actions for each of the remaining clinical sample tubes, using the same volumes and destination positions.
